coverageLimits: The inventory covers the 278 discovered public whole-bean, monthly-pick and green-coffee product pages, not every roaster or growing place worldwide.
A catalog option is not necessarily one coffee: sizes, bundles, blends and duplicate listings are not new origins.
Country-specific scans can produce overlapping candidate rows; the decisions ledger deduplicates product number plus original label.
Ambiguous farm names, unlocated trade labels and missing producer identity are retained without inventing a location.
Independent offerings used to enrich a region retain their own lot-specific processing, variety and flavor evidence. Original product labels are search terms, not geographic aliases.
Some public pages were verified using indexed primary-source text when live fetching was unavailable.
